claim: My pipeline (Claude + my afdb-sequence-mcp server, extended with the AF-ddG model) reports the AlphaFold DB pLDDT and AlphaMissense score at a variant site exactly as stored in AlphaFold DB, and predicts the variant's folding free-energy change to within RT ln 10 = 1.36 kcal/mol of experiment.
_notes: Thanh Ly, PHYS 7440, Meeting 1 ground-truth set (copied from ground_truth_template.json), used as the seed of the Assignment 8 test dataset.

Reference values were extracted by script from the cited records, never typed from memory or from an LLM: AlphaFold DB values from the API responses recorded on 2026-10-26 (Assignment 7 fixtures), ddG values from the S669 file.
kind: 'numeric' (compared in physical units via pint) or 'exact' (string match, case-insensitive). pLDDT and AlphaMissense scores are dimensionless (unit '').

tolerance: pLDDT +/-0.05 and AlphaMissense +/-0.0005 accept an answer rounded to one decimal place fewer than stored (pLDDT is stored to 0.01, AlphaMissense to 0.0001); ddG items use the domain rule in eval_harness.within_tolerance (|error| <= RT ln 10 = 1.36 kcal/mol, and no sign flip when |ddG_ref| >= 1 kcal/mol).
regime: 6 'typical' items the current pipeline should answer; 4 'edge' items (numbering ambiguity, a two-call derived quantity, and two ddG items, one asked in kJ/mol).
tool / arguments / field are used by --mode tool; 'field' is a dotted path into the server's {ok, data, ...} envelope. Edge items have no tool on purpose: they test the agent.
ddG items carry s669_protein / s669_mutation so baseline_ly.ipynb can check that they are S669 entries (the ground-truth set is the seed of the test dataset).
